import contextlib,io,json,sys,unittest
class R(unittest.TestResult):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.passed=[]
 def addSuccess(self,t): super().addSuccess(t); self.passed.append(t.id())
r=R()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()),contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()): unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('tests',pattern=sys.argv[1]).run(r)
print(json.dumps(dict(tests_run=r.testsRun,passed=len(r.passed),failed=len(r.failures),errors=len(r.errors),skipped=len(r.skipped),expected_failures=len(r.expectedFailures),unexpected_successes=len(r.unexpectedSuccesses),pass_ids=r.passed,skip_ids=[dict(id=t.id(),reason=s) for t,s in r.skipped],failure_ids=[t.id() for t,s in r.failures],error_ids=[t.id() for t,s in r.errors],successful=r.wasSuccessful())))
sys.exit(0 if r.wasSuccessful() else 1)

import contextlib,io,json,re,sys,unittest
class R(unittest.TestResult):
 def __init__(self): super().__init__(); self.passed=[]
 def addSuccess(self,t): super().addSuccess(t); self.passed.append(t.id())
r=R()
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()),contextlib.redirect_stderr(io.StringIO()):
 suite=unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName(sys.argv[1]) if sys.argv[1].startswith('test_license_server.') else unittest.defaultTestLoader.discover('tests',pattern=sys.argv[1])
 suite.run(r)
frames=[]
for t,s in r.failures+r.errors:
 frames.append(dict(id=t.id(),frames=[dict(file=p,line=int(n),function=f) for p,n,f in re.findall(r'File "([^\n"]+)", line (\d+), in ([^\n]+)',s)]))
print(json.dumps(dict(tests_run=r.testsRun,passed=len(r.passed),failed=len(r.failures),errors=len(r.errors),skipped=len(r.skipped),expected_failures=len(r.expectedFailures),unexpected_successes=len(r.unexpectedSuccesses),pass_ids=r.passed,skip_ids=[dict(id=t.id(),reason=s) for t,s in r.skipped],failure_ids=[t.id() for t,s in r.failures],error_ids=[t.id() for t,s in r.errors],sanitized_failure_frames=frames,successful=r.wasSuccessful())))
sys.exit(0 if r.wasSuccessful() else 1)

 frames.append(dict(id=t.id(),frames=[dict(file=p,line=int(n),function=f) for p,n,f in re.findall(r'File "([^\n"]+)", line (\d+), in ([^\n]+)',s)]))
print(json.dumps(dict(tests_run=r.testsRun,passed=len(r.passed),failed=len(r.failures),errors=len(r.errors),skipped=len(r.skipped),expected_failures=len(r.expectedFailures),unexpected_successes=len(r.unexpectedSuccesses),pass_ids=r.passed,skip_ids=[dict(id=t.id(),reason=s) for t,s in r.skipped],failure_ids=[t.id() for t,s in r.failures],error_ids=[t.id() for t,s in r.errors],sanitized_failure_frames=frames,successful=r.wasSuccessful())))
